definition: Not expected or anticipated before it happened.
book: The Life and Adventures of Robinson Crusoe
author: Daniel Defoe
quote: It was no less than eight days I had waited for them, when a strange and unforeseen accident intervened, of which the like has not, perhaps, been heard of in history.
